purpose: Teach: キミ/ハズ/みどり/蹴り/お許し/かんじ/はかり/相方

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「キミの未来が楽しみ」って仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad said he's looking forward to your future.
lines.style: Warm, gentle delivery. Slight smile in the voice. Shares the compliment like a gift, pausing just after his name to let it land. Soft, maternal cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが帰宅するハズが遅れてるよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad's supposed to be home by now, but he's running late.
lines.style: Quiet observation, not a complaint. Matter-of-fact but with the smallest undertone of concern. Speaks as if thinking out loud. No urgency—just noticing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家のみどりを増やしましょうね
lines.en: Sho — let's add more green plants around the house, shall we?
lines.style: Light, inviting tone. Opens with gentle enthusiasm. Includes him in a small domestic project. Warmth without pressure—an offer more than a suggestion.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ボールを蹴り過ぎて靴がボロボロだよ
lines.en: Mom — I've kicked the ball so much my shoes are falling apart.
lines.style: Self-aware, slightly rueful. Small laugh underneath. Not complaining—reporting it with a hint of wry acceptance, like he knows it's his own doing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんから「お許しを」って丁寧に頂いたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad asked my permission so politely. Apologized properly.
lines.style: Tender, almost touched. Speaks with quiet appreciation for his father's thoughtfulness. Softness in the middle of the phrase. Pauses slightly after 'permission' as if the gesture moved him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの優しさをかんじるよ
lines.en: Mom — I can feel Dad's kindness in everything he does.
lines.style: Soft, reverent almost. Slow, deliberate pace. Voice full—genuine warmth, not performed. Trailing slightly on the final word like he's summing something up that matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがケーキの分量をはかりで量って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad measured out the cake ingredients so carefully with the scale.
lines.style: Warm appreciation in the voice. Noticing the care in small details. Gentle admiration for his father's precision and effort. Steady, genuine tone—not exaggerated.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんは家族の相方だよね
lines.en: Mom — Dad is our family's partner, isn't he?
lines.style: Quiet realization, almost wondering aloud. Tender and definitive at once. Soft close on the final word. Like he's understanding something true that he's always known.
